svg.title: neofetch: thaitan@github
svg.desc: A neofetch-style card. A 3D voxel <T/> sculpture assembles block by block above a lit pedestal and floats; beside it a raised panel lists role: full-stack developer; location: soc trang, vietnam; shipping: typescript across the stack; stack: react, node.js, postgresql, aws; focus: clean architecture, testing; certs: meta, google, ibm, aws, deeplearning.ai; github: duongthaitan, each value decrypting from noise, above eight 3D colour cubes in the terminal ANSI palette.
